service_call.prompt: Edit the supplied existing video-game diffuse UV texture into a crisp HD painted texture. This is a flat 2:1 full-canvas UV atlas, NOT a weapon rendering or a product photograph. Reference 1 is the original authoritative RGBA source; reference 2 is its exact whole-canvas nearest-neighbor enlargement and adds NO new information. Keep every island, empty transparent region, edge silhouette, canvas-border clipping and normalized pixel-center position exactly. Do not move, crop, rotate, pad, recompose, complete cropped shapes, or redesign. Entire original 128x64 canvas must correspond linearly to entire output. Preserve original material colors: softly painted dark gray steel and understated warm brown wood where present, same shading direction and pattern scale. Improve fine material clarity within existing regions only. Keep original game-painted appearance; NO photorealistic weapon, new wear, damage, scratches, wood knots, curls, engraving, letters, logos, new hardware, holes, stripes, raised lips, or border bands. Compression/pixel blocks are not design ornaments; smooth existing material softly while obeying source shape and count. Preserve source transparency. Fine lines, black holes and tiny pale dots must stay at exact original UV centers and their original count/pitch/phase. Upper-left long metal perforated strip: preserve every tiny pale pin and every dark slot in the original two staggered rows at EXACT normalized pixel centers; preserve the three paired lower rectangular vent groups. Upper-right contains TWO separate small metal squares: one rectangular recess with its existing internal bars, and one circular dark mark with its existing V-shaped pale shading. Preserve the large warm orange-brown wood stock across lower half and right, the long middle metal inset, the existing small loop and bottom metal strip. Produce one HD full-canvas 2:1 atlas with no margin, no checkerboard, no caption and no comparison.
